title: JSON Diff Checker
h1: JSON Diff Checker — Compare JSON Online
seoTitle: JSON Diff Checker — Free Online JSON Compare
description: Compare two JSON documents and see added, removed and changed keys instantly. Private, runs in your browser with no upload.
intro: Paste two JSON objects or arrays and instantly see the differences: what was added, removed or modified. Perfect for debugging API responses or config changes.
blurb: Compare two JSON documents and highlight added, removed and changed keys. Free and private.
howItWorks: Paste or type the original JSON into the left box and the updated JSON into the right box.
Click Compare. The tool parses both and walks the structure to find differences.
Added keys, removed keys and value changes appear in the result area with a clear summary.
examples: Compare a local config.json with the one returned by an API to spot unexpected changes.
Check two versions of a package.json or tsconfig to see what dependencies or options changed.

faq.q: Is my JSON uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Both documents are parsed and compared entirely inside your browser. Nothing leaves your device.

faq.q: What if the JSON is invalid?
faq.a: The tool shows a clear error message pointing to the problem instead of a partial result.

faq.q: Does it handle nested objects and arrays?
faq.a: Yes. It recursively compares objects and arrays, reporting path-based differences.
